title: Individual - Data API
description: Represents a customer’s data privacy and protection preferences. Data privacy records based on the Individual object store your customers’ preferences. Data privacy records are associated with related leads, contacts, person accounts, and users. This object is available in API version 42.0 and later.

BirthDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

CanStorePiiElsewhere.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanStorePiiElsewhere.description: Indication that you can store the customer’s personally identifiable information (PII) outside of their legislation area. For example, you could store an EU citizen’s PII data in the US.

ChildrenCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ChildrenCount.description: The number of children the customer has.

ConsumerCreditScore.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ConsumerCreditScoreProviderName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ConsumerCreditScoreProviderName.description: The name of the company that provided the credit score.

ConvictionsCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ConvictionsCount.description: The number of convictions for the customer.

DeathDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

FirstName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FirstName.description: The customer’s first name. Maximum size is 40 characters.

HasOptedOutGeoTracking.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasOptedOutGeoTracking.description: Preference to not track geolocation on mobile devices.

HasOptedOutProcessing.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasOptedOutProcessing.description: Preference to not process personal data, which can include collecting, storing, and sharing personal data.

HasOptedOutProfiling.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasOptedOutProfiling.description: Preference to not process data for predicting personal attributes, such as interests, behavior, and location.

HasOptedOutSolicit.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasOptedOutSolicit.description: Preference to not solicit products and services.

HasOptedOutTracking.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasOptedOutTracking.description: Preference to not track customer web activity and whether the customer opens email sent through Salesforce.

HasPrivacyHold.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update

IndividualsAge.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
IndividualsAge.description: Indicates whether the customer is considered to be a minor.

InfluencerRating.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InfluencerRating.description: A measure of the person's influence, irrespective of how we do business with them.

IsHomeOwner.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsHomeOwner.description: Indicates whether the customer owns a home.

LastName.description: The customer’s last name. Maximum size is 80 characters.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record.

MasterRecordId.description: If this object was deleted as the result of a merge, this field contains the ID of the record that was kept. If this object was deleted for any other reason, or hasn’t been deleted, the value is null. This is a relationship field.

MilitaryService.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MilitaryService.description: Indicates whether the customer has served in the military.

Name.description: Concatenation of FirstName and LastName. Maximum size is 203 characters, including whitespaces.

Occupation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Occupation.description: The customer’s occupation. Maximum size is 150 characters.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of the account associated with this customer. This is a relationship field.

Salutation.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Salutation.description: The title for addressing the customer, such as Dr. or Mrs.

SendIndividualData.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
SendIndividualData.description: Preference to export personal data for delivery to the customer.

ShouldForget.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
ShouldForget.description: Preference to delete records and personal data related to this customer.

Website.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Website.description: The URL for the customer’s website.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **IndividualChangeEvent (API version 47.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **IndividualHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **IndividualShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
